provenance.author: Roll for Shoes (rollforshoes.com)
provenance.entries: Source tables verbatim or lightly reworded. Entries marked src=pocketrpg are original additions where the source gives only a prompt.

setting.premise: A team of skilled specialists plans and pulls off a big score: steal one valuable or important item.

heist.twist.v: The item is in another location
A double-cross: one of the team is working against the team
A trap is sprung, capturing at least one of the team
Another thief or team is going after the item
The item is not what it seems
The authorities get the jump on the team

questions.text: Where is it, and how is it secured?

segments.name: Planning and Recon
segments.text: In character, set up connections, obstacles and positioning. Prompt with problems the location raises until there is enough to outline the heist.

segments.name: Action!
segments.text: Each character gets a turn to advance the plan through the obstacles and NPCs, with the item as the goal. Near the end, introduce a twist.

segments.name: The Escape
segments.text: Raise the pressure until they want out, item or not. Bring back obstacles and NPCs. End on a cliffhanger or set piece.

story.note: Larger groups: add NPC teammates (Teammate generator) to support the PCs.
